summary: A radar chart for My team with six sliders that edit each dimension live.
use: Letting users build or tweak a skill or score profile and see the shape update.
spec: `{#each DIMS as dim, i}` renders one `<Slider value={dims[i]} min={0} max={100} step={1}`
`onchange={(v) => { dims[i] = v[0]; }}` writes back the first slider value
Each row shows the dimension name and `{dims[i]}` in a `<Flex justify="between">`
